_comment: Illustrative starter IoC feed shipped with AgentFirewall. These are demo/reserved values used by the example artifacts and docs, NOT a real threat feed. Point `afw scan --intel <path>` at your own maintained feeds, or drop files into ~/.config/agentfirewall/intel/. Formats: this JSON schema, or names.txt / domains.txt / hashes.txt / signers.txt / packages.txt.
_packages_note: 'packages' lists suspect/AI-hallucinated dependency names (slopsquatting). Left empty on purpose — supply your own so real package names are never wrongly flagged.
